name: @prism3/engine
description: The Prism3 token-generation engine — dependency-free TypeScript, run via tsx. No build step: the `exports` map below points at the .ts sources, which the surfaces bundle themselves.
//: NO build script and NO dependencies, both deliberate (#650). `exports` is CONFIGURATION, not compilation — a resolver reads this map to turn '@prism3/engine/theme' into a path, and esbuild/tsx then handle the TypeScript. Adding a build step here would mean the surfaces bundle emitted JS instead of source, which is the property that keeps the plugin's main.js free of node: builtins. Version tracks ENGINE_VERSION in version.ts.
